subject.title: [Bug]: MCP tools not injected into subagent (sessions_spawn) sessions — `bundle-mcp` + per-tool subagent allowlist + per-agent allowlist all ignored, subagent system prompt and tool schema receive only built-ins

question: Should the linked fix preserve deferred MCP/LSP/plugin selector tokens for spawned children only after the complete parent authorization chain has filtered them?
rationale: The reported regression blocks a documented workflow, but selector propagation crosses the MCP tool-policy boundary and needs maintainer confirmation that the chosen inheritance semantics do not broaden a child’s authority.

options.title: Review the filtered-selector repair
options.body: Validate https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103017 against every policy layer and merge only if allowed and denied runtime-tool cases are both proven.

options.title: Request a narrower redesign
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for an alternative implementation if the linked PR cannot demonstrate that selector inheritance preserves existing deny semantics.

recommendation.title: Review the filtered-selector repair
recommendation.body: Validate https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103017 against every policy layer and merge only if allowed and denied runtime-tool cases are both proven.
